experiment: Experiment 4.5.3: Independent Structural Persistence Integration Audit
summary: Core persistence, end-to-end REST/WebSocket wiring, and disabled-mode parity are verified. However, two critical/high architectural limitations were discovered and reproduced: (1) top_doc SVOA bias causing wrongful exclusion of correct structural records, and (2) rejection of pure-structural documents when SVOA count is 0.

reproduced_defects.title: Hidden SVOA Dependency in Multi-Document Structural Selection (top_doc Bias)
reproduced_defects.description: When SVOA facts from Document A rank #1 due to lexical prose overlap, top_doc is assigned to Document A. If Document A has any structural chunk with sim >= 0.25, the system selects only Document A chunks and drops more relevant structural chunks (e.g. sim 0.75+) from Document B.

reproduced_defects.title: Rejection of Pure-Structural Documents by REST/WebSocket Handlers
reproduced_defects.description: If an ingested document consists entirely of tables or lists (producing 0 SVOA facts), store.count() == 0. Both POST /api/query and WebSocket _handle_ws_query reject queries with HTTP 400 or error: "No documents ingested", even though structural evidence exists in the store.

reproduced_defects.title: Starvation of Non-fact_docs Structural Candidates by matched_items
reproduced_defects.description: The expression (matched_items if matched_items else other_items) completely starves other_items if any item in matched_items exists, regardless of similarity scores.

reproduced_defects.title: Inflated Test Accounting in Experiment 4.5.2 Report
reproduced_defects.description: Double-counted 77 tests that are part of backend/tests/ by summing individual test files with the full suite total.
